tour.title: Project Overview & Documentation
tour.description: Start with the project README and AGENTS.md to understand DogVita's purpose: a React Native app connecting to an ESP32-S3 dog collar via BLE for real-time health tracking, GPS geofencing, and alerts. Learn the tech stack (RN 0.76, Zustand, Supabase, BLE) and the critical build quirk requiring a short Windows path for Gradle.

tour.title: App Entry Point & Bootstrap
tour.description: Follow the boot sequence: index.js polyfills Hermes (URL/URLSearchParams for Supabase-js), then registers the App component. App.tsx wraps AppContent with ThemeProvider, GestureHandlerRootView, and SafeAreaProvider, while AppContent manages splash screen dismissal and notification listener lifecycle.

tour.title: Navigation & Auth Guard
tour.description: RootNavigator is the traffic controller: it checks Supabase session state and settingsStore onboarding flag to decide between the OnboardingNavigator (Welcome → SignUp → Login → OTP → SetupDog → PairDevice) and the MainTabNavigator. The MainTabNavigator provides 4 tabs: Dashboard, Health, Tracking, and Chatbot with a floating rounded bottom bar.

tour.title: State Management (Zustand Stores)
tour.description: Seven Zustand stores manage all app state: dogStore (profiles, CRUD, weight trends), healthStore (heart rate, temperature, activity from BLE), bleStore (device connection state), trackingStore (GPS, geofences, routes), alertStore (health alerts with real-time Supabase subscription), settingsStore (persisted user prefs), and chatStore (AI chat messages). Critical rule: selectors must be pure — no method calls or new refs inside selectors.

tour.title: BLE Communication Layer
tour.description: The BLE subsystem has four layers: BLEScanner discovers devices using react-native-ble-plx with timeout-based auto-stop and Android permission handling. BLEConnectionManager handles connect/disconnect, characteristic read/write, and notification monitoring. BLEPacketParser decodes base64-encoded packets into structured health metrics (heart rate, GPS, temperature, battery, steps). BLEService is the facade coordinating all three.

tour.title: Health Monitoring & Analytics
tour.description: Health data flows from BLE packets into healthStore, then to the HealthOverviewScreen displaying heart rate, temperature, and activity metrics. useHealthMetrics hook computes a 0-100 health score. HeartRateChart visualizes historical data with min/max indicators. The analytics service provides trend analysis, heart rate zone classification, sleep quality scoring, and abnormal value detection.

tour.title: GPS Tracking & Geofencing
tour.description: GPSService wraps React Native Geolocation API for permissions, current location, continuous tracking, reverse geocoding, and Haversine distance calculation. trackingStore manages locations, geofences, and route history with Supabase persistence and offline fallback. DogMap renders markers, polylines, and geofence circles using react-native-maps, with OpenStreetMapView and OfflineMapView as fallbacks.

tour.title: Backend Integration (Supabase)
tour.description: The API layer provides Supabase CRUD for dogs, health metrics, devices, alerts, and tracking. supabase.ts initializes the client and manages real-time Postgres change subscriptions. AuthService handles email/password sign-up, phone OTP verification, session management, and clears all 6 persisted store keys on sign-out. The storage service wraps MMKV (sync) and AsyncStorage (async) for key-value persistence.

tour.title: UI Components & Theme System
tour.description: The component library includes common primitives (Button, Card, Input, Header, Loader, EmptyState, ErrorView, StatusBadge), domain components (DogCard, DeviceCard), chart components (HeartRateChart), and map components (DogMap, OpenStreetMapView, OfflineMapView). The theme system defines colors (light/dark), spacing scale, typography, shadows, and a ThemeContext provider that reads the user's preference from settingsStore.

tour.title: Build & Configuration
tour.description: Metro bundler config stubs Node.js builtins (http, crypto, fs, etc.) via empty-module.js for Supabase-js compatibility. Babel uses react-native-dotenv for @env imports. TypeScript is strict mode with ESNext target. The build must run from C:\R\dog-health-app (short path) due to Windows MAX_PATH limit. JAVA_HOME must point to Android Studio's bundled JDK. Custom hooks (useBLE, useAlerts, useLocation, useTheme) bridge services to components.
